mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the heating coil made the heat exchange and separation of the two fluids concrete and understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the tank felt routine, and the explanation repeated the fluid-separation point already made when fitting the coil.

surprise.text: The room-facing insulation can fold back to release stored warmth, an arrangement I had not expected.

arbitrary.text: None felt purposeless, though every decision offered only one combination, so there was little meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in continuing for the practical engineering explanations, but the predictable, single-option sequence makes the gameplay itself less compelling.
